items.label: FAST DUMPING & NEAT ORGANIZATION
items.value: When you want to empty the waste tank at the end of vacation, RVMATE drain hose support can make dumping easier and more efficiently, no need to hold sewer hose and find shoes covered with waste!

items.label: QUICKLY SET UP
items.value: Place the hose support under RV waste port and pull it to sewer connection, then put the sewer hose on the support( reduce the amount of wear on the sewer hose when extending ). With the help of flexible accordion design, the hose support could be adjusted to fit around a corner and other obstacles.

items.label: DOWNWARD SLOPE DESIGN
items.value: After placing the hose support, you could see the sewer hose sloping downward towards the dumping station naturally, the waste will move through the hose quickly without being stuck inside the hose.

items.label: GREAT for OUTDOOR USE
items.value: Made of UV-resistant and lightweight plastic， the support is able to lift the hose stably under the circumstance of plenty rain and strong sunlight.

items.label: USEFUL ACCESSORIES
items.value: Every sewer hose support comes with non-slip gloves, thick organization strap and elastic anchor cords, keeping hands clean and making storage much easier. PATENTED.
